Definition: from G4862 and G5021; to arrange jointly, i.e. (figuratively) to direct:--appoint.
BiblicalUsage: The disciples do as Jesus appoints them, and make ready the passover, and they go and do as Jesus commands them with the ass and the colt. The appointing is a direction given and obeyed, and the passover and the colt are both made ready by disciples who do exactly as they are told.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe obedience to Jesus's appointment is the whole of discipleship, and I hold that the passover was made ready because the disciples did as He said.
